dimensions.assessment: Directly affects Gila County, local Forest Service administration, and regional veterans.
Transfers a specific 232.9-acre parcel of land for a dedicated public purpose.
dimensions.evidence: consisting of approximately 232.9 acres of National Forest System land located in the Tonto National Forest in Arizona

dimensions.assessment: Conveyed without consideration, with all administrative and survey costs covered by the county.
dimensions.evidence: made without consideration... the County shall pay all costs associated with the conveyance

dimensions.assessment: A localized land conveyance law with no general regulatory changes.
Permanent property transfer subject to federal reversion if land use terms are violated.
dimensions.evidence: If any land conveyed under subsection (b) is used in a manner that is inconsistent with the requirements of subsection (g), all right, title, and interest in and to the land shall revert to the United States
